description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures also triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 7.
